user.title: Deliveroo
user.description: Unofficial integration: it reads your order status the same way the Deliveroo website does. Only Italy has been fully tested.

data_description.consumer_auth_token: Value of the `consumer_auth_token` cookie from your country's Deliveroo website (browser DevTools → Application → Cookies). It lasts about 60 days.

reauth_confirm.title: Deliveroo session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Log in again on the Deliveroo website and paste the new `consumer_auth_token` cookie.

data_description.consumer_auth_token: Value of the `consumer_auth_token` cookie from your country's Deliveroo website (browser DevTools → Application → Cookies). It lasts about 60 days.

error.invalid_auth: The cookie is not valid or has expired.
error.blocked: Deliveroo's bot protection rejected the request. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This Deliveroo account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The cookie belongs to a different Deliveroo account.

init.title: Polling intervals
init.description: How often Home Assistant checks Deliveroo. Checking for new orders is a tiny request (a few bytes), so it can be frequent.

data_description.active_interval: Seconds, between 10 and 120. The Deliveroo website itself refreshes about every 15 seconds.
